supplements.title: Plant‑derived natural products alleviate dexamethasone‑induced skeletal muscle atrophy by modulating FoxO (Review).
supplements.summary: Plant-derived compounds prevent muscle wasting caused by dexamethasone by targeting the FoxO protein and related cellular pathways.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the combined cytotoxic and apoptotic potential of green-synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles (from Thymus vulgaris) and tamoxifen on MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Thymus-derived zinc oxide nanoparticles combined with tamoxifen kill breast cancer cells while using 96-fold less tamoxifen dose.

supplements.title: A natural product-hybridization approach toward anticancer drug discovery: synthesis and antitumor evaluation of CTBC6, designed from sulforaphane and magnolol.
supplements.summary: CTBC6, a hybrid compound derived from natural products, effectively kills breast cancer cells by blocking key signaling pathways and targeting specific proteins.

supplements.title: Bioactive treatments against chronic myeloid leukemia from Hypericum lancasteri targeting p53 pathway.
supplements.summary: Plant compounds from Hypericum lancasteri kill chronic myeloid leukemia cells by activating the p53 cancer-fighting pathway.

supplements.title: UPLC-Q-TOF-MS/MS guided isolation of phyllanfranchins A-D, two pairs of undescribed cytotoxic dichapetalin hybrid triterpenoid epimers from Phyllanthus franchetianus.
supplements.summary: Researchers isolated four new plant compounds from Phyllanthus franchetianus that kill multiple cancer cell types, with one showing potent activity against lung cancer.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective effects of pepsin-hydrolyzed ovotransferrin on H2O2-induced oxidative damage in SH-SY5Y neuronal cells.
supplements.summary: Pepsin-processed egg white protein protects nerve cells from oxidative damage by reducing harmful molecules and preventing cell death.

supplements.title: Exercise training prior to and during cancer in mice preserves muscle mass, reduces tumour weight and suppresses molecular mediators of cachexia.
supplements.summary: Exercise before and during colon cancer preserves muscle mass, reduces tumor growth, and suppresses cancer-related muscle wasting in mice.

supplements.title: Autophagy activation by urolithin-a derivative UA-36 mitigates Friedreich's ataxia pathologies induced by frataxin deficiency.
supplements.summary: UA-36, a urolithin derivative, improves Friedreich's ataxia symptoms in mice by activating autophagy and restoring mitochondrial function.

supplements.title: In silico discovery of natural compounds from Vietnamese essential oils database with target binding to cancer-related proteins.
supplements.summary: Vietnamese essential oil compounds show promise against multiple cancer types through computational screening of cancer-related protein targets.

supplements.title: Baicalin attenuates angiotensin II-induced vascular endothelial injury via targeted activation of the Nrf2 signaling pathway: Integrated computational and in vitro evidence.
supplements.summary: Baicalin protects blood vessel cells from damage by activating Nrf2, a protective pathway that shields against oxidative stress.

supplements.title: α-Viniferin Induces Intrinsic Apoptosis in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Cells and Synergizes With SB203580 Independently of p38 Mitogen-Activated Protein Kinase.
supplements.summary: A natural compound called α-viniferin kills triple-negative breast cancer cells and works better when combined with another drug.

supplements.title: α-Linolenic acid alleviates ovalbumin-induced allergic rhinitis in mice and modulates GPR120-NF-κB signaling.
supplements.summary: Alpha-linolenic acid reduces allergic rhinitis symptoms in mice by decreasing inflammation and blocking a key immune signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Esculentoside A suppresses the malignant progression of hepatocellular carcinoma by promoting RORB.
supplements.summary: Esculentoside A slows liver cancer growth by activating a protein called RORB that blocks cancer-promoting Wnt signaling.

supplements.title: Gambogic acid induces cell death via covalent binding with PRDX1 to regulate ER stress and autophagy.
supplements.summary: Gambogic acid, a natural compound in clinical trials, kills renal cancer cells by binding to a protein that triggers cell stress and death.

supplements.title: Efficacy and Mechanism of Silymarin Extract for Deep Second-Degree Burns in Rats.
supplements.summary: Silymarin extract promotes healing of deep second-degree burns in rats by reducing inflammation and supporting tissue repair.

off_label.title: FusionTarget: Computational framework for drug repurposing against modeled fusion protein structures from genomic breakpoints.
off_label.summary: FusionTarget computationally identifies drugs targeting fusion proteins in Ewing sarcoma and infant leukemia by modeling their 3D structures.

off_label.title: Protein tyrosine kinases in dendritic cell-mediated anti-cancer immunity.
off_label.summary: Protein tyrosine kinases control dendritic cells' ability to fight cancer by regulating immune responses, and targeting these proteins may enhance cancer immunotherapy.

off_label.title: Targeting XIAP-coordinated PKC signaling resensitizes PD-1-refractory tumors for rechallenge.
off_label.summary: PKC inhibition resensitizes PD-1-resistant lung cancer to immunotherapy by reactivating immune cell killing and reducing tumor protection.

off_label.title: Unlocking the potential of TNF: From biologic agents to small-molecule inhibitors.
off_label.summary: Researchers are developing oral small-molecule TNF inhibitors to replace injectable biologics, offering better accessibility and lower costs for inflammatory disease treatment.

off_label.title: Nutrient stress-induced FTH1 safeguards redox balance and fuels pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma growth while serving as a therapeutic target and diagnostic biomarker.
off_label.summary: A protein called FTH1 helps pancreatic cancer cells survive nutrient stress, making it both a therapeutic target and a potential treatment response indicator.

off_label.title: Ivonescimab Plus Chemo Extends Squamous NSCLC Survival.
off_label.summary: Ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy significantly improves survival in advanced squamous lung cancer compared to standard immunotherapy.

off_label.title: ACY-1215 ameliorates experimental colitis by inhibiting dendritic cell maturation and Th1/Th17 responses.
off_label.summary: ACY-1215 reduces colitis by blocking immune cells from activating harmful inflammatory responses in the gut.

off_label.title: Colchicine attenuates kidney injury by modulating the NLRP3 inflammasome pathway.
off_label.summary: Colchicine reduces kidney damage in chronic kidney disease by turning off an inflammatory pathway called NLRP3.

off_label.title: Fluvoxamine and lycopene alleviate cisplatin-induced kidney fibrosis by modulating miR-21 and fibrotic signaling pathways.
off_label.summary: Fluvoxamine and lycopene protect kidneys from cisplatin chemotherapy damage by reducing inflammation, oxidative stress, and fibrosis in rats.

off_label.title: Ketone bodies as guardians of leukemic stemness through ferroptosis suppression.
off_label.summary: Leukemia stem cells use ketones to block a type of cell death, suggesting a new treatment target.

off_label.title: Impact of Beta-2 Adrenergic Blockade With Checkpoint Inhibition in Checkpoint Inhibitor Refractory Metastatic Triple Negative Breast Cancer
off_label.summary: Propranolol combined with pembrolizumab may help triple negative breast cancer patients who stopped responding to checkpoint inhibitor therapy.

off_label.title: A Single-Arm, Phase II Study of Autophagy Modulation Using Hydroxychloroquine in Combination With Encorafenib and Cetuximab or Panitumumab in Metastatic BRAF-mutated Colorectal Cancer Refractory to Standard Therapies
off_label.summary: Hydroxychloroquine added to standard drugs improved treatment outcomes for metastatic colorectal cancer with BRAF mutations resistant to prior therapies.

off_label.title: Phase I Study Evaluating Indomethacin in Combination With Platinum-based Chemotherapy
off_label.summary: Indomethacin combined with platinum-based chemotherapy is safe and may prevent drug resistance caused by immune cells in cancer patients.

off_label.title: M.globosa promotes lung cancer progression and M2 macrophage polarization through oxidative phosphorylation.
off_label.summary: M.globosa fungus promotes lung cancer growth by activating immune cells through a metabolic process that can be blocked by metformin.

off_label.title: Comprehensive multi-omics analysis identifies cancer subtypes and prognostic signatures of hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified two hepatocellular carcinoma subtypes and developed a prognostic tool that predicted outcomes better than existing models, revealing KX2-391 as a promising new treatment.

biomarkers.title: The tumor microenvironment in triple negative breast cancer and a strategy to improve responses to immunotherapy using cryoablation and immunostimulants.
biomarkers.summary: Combining cryoablation with immunotherapy drugs may improve treatment outcomes for triple-negative breast cancer by activating the immune system.

biomarkers.title: Neoplastic CD3⁺ B cells remodel the DLBCL tumor microenvironment via single-cell and spatial transcriptomics.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers created a detailed map of DLBCL tumor cells and their surroundings using advanced imaging and genetic analysis techniques.

biomarkers.title: Genetic variants of the transporter SLC22A4 affect the abundance and survival of Fusobacterium nucleatum in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A genetic variant in the SLC22A4 transporter allows harmful bacteria to thrive in colorectal cancer by weakening immune responses.

biomarkers.title: Plant‑derived natural products alleviate dexamethasone‑induced skeletal muscle atrophy by modulating FoxO (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Plant-derived compounds prevent muscle wasting caused by dexamethasone by targeting the FoxO protein and related cellular pathways.

biomarkers.title: Targeted therapy in BRAF‑mutant melanoma: Advances and challenges (Review).
biomarkers.summary: BRAF inhibitors effectively treat melanoma but patients develop drug resistance, requiring new strategies to prevent aggressive cancer relapse.

biomarkers.title: Targeting regulatory T cells in the prostate cancer microenvironment: From mechanisms to therapeutics (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Targeting specific regulatory T cell subsets in prostate cancer tumors could improve immunotherapy effectiveness and prevent treatment-induced immune suppression.

biomarkers.title: Beyond the primary site: Molecular insights and clinical implications of cancer metastatic overlap between lung and urological organ cancers (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Lung and urological cancers share molecular pathways enabling metastasis between organs, requiring personalized treatment strategies tailored to each organ's microenvironment.

biomarkers.title: LINC01117 promotes the malignant proliferation of lung adenocarcinoma by increasing HOXD8 mRNA stability.
biomarkers.summary: A molecule called LINC01117 promotes lung adenocarcinoma growth by stabilizing another molecule, HOXD8, which drives cancer cell proliferation.

biomarkers.title: Evaluation of the combined cytotoxic and apoptotic potential of green-synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles (from Thymus vulgaris) and tamoxifen on MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
biomarkers.summary: Thymus-derived zinc oxide nanoparticles combined with tamoxifen kill breast cancer cells while using 96-fold less tamoxifen dose.

biomarkers.title: Metabolic remodeling by circular RNAs in gastric tumorigenesis: From mechanisms to biomarker discovery (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Circular RNAs help gastric cancer cells reprogram their metabolism to support growth and spread, offering potential new biomarkers and treatment targets.

biomarkers.title: Emerging agents that target signaling pathways in cancer fibroblast cells (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Targeting signaling pathways in cancer-supporting fibroblasts with small molecule drugs may inhibit tumor growth and metastasis.

biomarkers.title: Growth hormone-secreting adenoma with lack of retinoblastoma protein expression.
biomarkers.summary: A patient with an RB1 gene mutation developed a growth hormone-secreting pituitary tumor lacking retinoblastoma protein expression.

biomarkers.title: Functioning gonadotroph macroadenoma associated with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1.
biomarkers.summary: A rare functioning pituitary tumor in MEN1 syndrome caused abnormal hormone levels and gynecologic symptoms, treated with surgery.

biomarkers.title: High-throughput protein target mapping enables accelerated bioactivity discovery for ToxCast and PFAS compounds.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified how toxic chemicals, especially PFAS pollutants, bind to human proteins, revealing that newer replacement compounds interact more broadly than legacy versions.

biomarkers.title: FusionTarget: Computational framework for drug repurposing against modeled fusion protein structures from genomic breakpoints.
biomarkers.summary: FusionTarget computationally identifies drugs targeting fusion proteins in Ewing sarcoma and infant leukemia by modeling their 3D structures.

trials.title: The tumor microenvironment in triple negative breast cancer and a strategy to improve responses to immunotherapy using cryoablation and immunostimulants.
trials.summary: Combining cryoablation with immunotherapy drugs may improve treatment outcomes for triple-negative breast cancer by activating the immune system.

trials.title: Targeted therapy in BRAF‑mutant melanoma: Advances and challenges (Review).
trials.summary: BRAF inhibitors effectively treat melanoma but patients develop drug resistance, requiring new strategies to prevent aggressive cancer relapse.

trials.title: Targeting regulatory T cells in the prostate cancer microenvironment: From mechanisms to therapeutics (Review).
trials.summary: Targeting specific regulatory T cell subsets in prostate cancer tumors could improve immunotherapy effectiveness and prevent treatment-induced immune suppression.

trials.title: Covalent inhibitors of human papillomavirus type 16 E6 protein restore p53 function and suppress growth of HPV-driven tumors in vivo.
trials.summary: A new drug blocks HPV-16's cancer protein, restoring tumor suppressor p53 function and shrinking cervical and oropharyngeal tumors in mice.

trials.title: Protein tyrosine kinases in dendritic cell-mediated anti-cancer immunity.
trials.summary: Protein tyrosine kinases control dendritic cells' ability to fight cancer by regulating immune responses, and targeting these proteins may enhance cancer immunotherapy.

trials.title: Quality of life and mental health in pediatric patients with low-grade CNS tumors treated with surgery alone.
trials.summary: Children with low-grade brain tumors treated with surgery alone experience reduced quality of life and mental health challenges compared to healthy peers.

trials.title: Impact of prior nivolumab on treatment outcomes of taxane plus ramucirumab in advanced gastric cancer.
trials.summary: Prior immune checkpoint inhibitor treatment may improve how well taxane plus ramucirumab works for advanced gastric cancer.

trials.title: Diagnostic Challenges in Oncogenic Osteomalacia due to Intracranial Phosphaturic Mesenchymal Tumor: A Case Report.
trials.summary: A rare brain tumor causing bone weakness was successfully treated with surgery, leading to complete recovery and normalized bone health.

trials.title: Engagement of the TCR against an oncolytic virus generates a population of effector CAR T cells with potent antitumor activity.
trials.summary: Combining CAR T cells with oncolytic virus therapy enhances T cell durability and anti-tumor activity in solid tumors.

trials.title: Differential DNA damage response to WRN inhibition identifies a targetable vulnerability in ARID1A-mutated cancers.
trials.summary: Blocking WRN protein selectively kills ARID1A-mutated cancers, especially when combined with p21 inhibition.

trials.title: Cytotoxic CD39+ tumor-associated NK cells respond to NKG2A blockade in lung cancer.
trials.summary: Blocking NKG2A enhances the cancer-killing ability of CD39+ immune cells in lung cancer patients.

trials.title: The impact of novel bet inhibitors on the treatment armamentarium of Myelofibrosis.
trials.summary: New BET inhibitor drugs show promise as a treatment option for myelofibrosis by targeting disease-causing molecular pathways.

trials.title: Clinicopathological features and ethnic disparities of melanoma in the United Arab Emirates: 2017-2025.
trials.summary: Researchers studied melanoma cases in the UAE to understand how the disease presents differently across ethnic groups in a high-UV environment.

trials.title: Discovery of Highly Potent and Selective SOS1 Inhibitors for the Treatment of KRAS-Driven Colorectal Cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers developed new drug compounds that block SOS1 protein, effectively stopping colorectal cancer cell growth driven by KRAS mutations.

trials.title: Fumarate Hydratase-deficient Renal Cell Carcinoma - A Multicentric Comprehensive Clinical, Pathological, and Molecular Analysis of 12 Cases.
trials.summary: Fumarate hydratase-deficient kidney cancer is a rare, aggressive subtype best diagnosed through combined immunohistochemical testing for FH and 2SC protein loss.
